'''Wenmo''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is the son of [[Wenshui]] who can be found located in various spots nearby his father.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Idle during day)
:'''Wenmo''' Wow, a device I've never seen before, what would happen if I disassembled it?
:'''Wenmo''' A top-heavy structure. Will it be more solid?
:'''Wenmo''' That thing is too high. I can't see the design of the other side. Oh how I wish to grow taller.

;(Talk at night near-by his father)
:'''Wenmo:''' {{MC|m=Big brother|f=Big sister}}, you are here again, shh... wait a moment.
:'''Wenmo:''' I'm at a crucial step in the disassembly, if I messed up the order, it can never be restored.
:'''Wenmo:''' Oh no, gotta head back, or my dad's gonna get mad at me, Let's play some other time.
{{Dialogue End}}
